title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Nvidia surged 8.7% Thursday after guiding to 70% revenue growth next fiscal year (vs. 45% expected); Nasdaq closed at 26,541 (+1.6%), S&P 500 at 7,731 (+0.7%), Dow at 53,569 (+0.2%)
Markets: US futures slipped and gold held near $4,600 early Friday as traders await Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech (10am ET); crude oil near $83.50/bbl
Companies: Salesforce jumped ~23% on a new 'Claudeforce' partnership with Anthropic plus a Q2 beat and raised FY27 guidance; software peers CrowdStrike and Okta rallied too

Companies: Marvell fell over 7% after-hours despite meeting/beating estimates, on elevated expectations; new tariffs on Canadian autos and semiconductors hit chip/auto supply chains, with Micron down ~3%

Macro/Policy: Boston Fed's Susan Collins said further rate hikes could be warranted if inflation doesn't cool; scrutiny is growing over Treasury Secretary Bessent's expanding involvement near the Fed's turf ahead of Warsh's address
